weaknesses: The abstract does not accurately reflect the focus on deep residual networks and their implicit regularization towards neural ODEs.
The paper lacks a clear discussion on the limitations of the proposed methods and assumptions made during the analysis.
The experimental section could benefit from additional baselines to better contextualize the results.
strengths: The theoretical contributions provide a solid framework for understanding the connection between deep residual networks and neural ODEs.
The use of numerical experiments effectively illustrates the theoretical findings and supports the claims made in the paper.
The paper is well-structured and presents complex ideas in a clear and accessible manner.
